newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy exploring aid effort for Albania.
newsitem.headline: Italy exploring aid effort for Albania.

text.p: Italy said on Tuesday it was sounding out other countries and international organisations on the prospects of aid for Albania.

The former Stalinist country, Europe's poorest state, has been hit by anti-government riots triggered by the collapse of shady pyramid investment schemes in which many Albanians had sunk their life savings.

"We will see what type of aid could eventually be agreed to help Albania overcome this difficult economic, financial and political situation," Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini told reporters. He did not elaborate.
Diplomatic sources said Italy was exploring possible aid through the European Union and international financial institutions.

Italy, which briefly occupied Albania during World War Two, lies a short distance across the Adriatic from the small Balkan country and has seen an influx of illegal Albanian immigrants since the collapse of Stalinist rule.
Diplomats say Rome fears a full-scale crisis in Albania could trigger a huge exodus to its shores similar in scale to one in 1991, when some 45,000 Albanians poured in.
